Register online through Pasadena Humane's foster page; first-timers welcome and supplies plus staff phone support are provided. Dogs are picked up at the Raymond Ave. animal center during set windows (e.g. holiday sleepovers like Thanksgiving 2026 had online sign-up deadlines). Pasadena Humane also handles animal services for Glendale and other nearby cities.
